author: Universal Save Editor (community research)
description: Real-game schema, built from public documentation (Bulbapedia's 'Save data structure (Generation IV)' page and Project Pokémon's DP Save Structure / NDS checksum docs) rather than a captured real save file — NOT independently verified against an actual save or the game's own behavior. Covers only the primary save block-pair's small block (trainer info); the backup block-pair and the Pokémon party/box data are out of scope. Diamond and Pearl share this engine/layout; Platinum and HeartGold/SoulSilver use different offsets and are NOT covered by this schema. If you test this against a real save, please report back so it can be corrected or confirmed.

fingerprints.description: Exact 512KB save size plus a self-consistent CRC16 over the small block — a checksum that validates is strong evidence independent of any single fixed byte guess.

fields.name: Trainer Name (raw bytes)
fields.description: Generation IV games use a proprietary character encoding (not ASCII/UTF-16), which this schema does not yet decode — shown as raw bytes so it can still be inspected/edited without silently corrupting it into garbled in-game text.

checksums.description: Recalculated after any edit in the primary block-pair's small block. The backup block-pair (offset +0x40000) is intentionally left untouched by this schema.
